title: STILL-PRESENT: types.odin Event comment keeps the false 'pre-4.2 streams byte-identical' claim — W3-carry fix incomplete
detail: The r2 W3 fix demanded types.odin adopt serialize.odin's wording. The admission sentence was added, but the contradicted byte-identity sentence remains verbatim — one comment now asserts both the fold and byte-identity.
recommended_fix: Replace the trailing sentence with serialize.odin's wording: pre-4.2 drop payloads gained 4 shed-bundle bytes, so pre-4.2 event streams are not byte-identical; only tags 8/9 are append-only.
